messages:
Alice M: Heads up — emergency deploy request for embeddings service. KV-cache eviction bug is causing sporadic 503s in eu-west1. Need an expedited surge window and signoff to push a hotfix. Planned approach: manual canary -> 10% -> 50% -> full over ~15m. Requesting rollcall and pin for the canary image. @oncall please confirm SLO risk.
DeployBot: automated check: canary image built: `registry.redwood/embeddings:hotfix-2026-03-21`. Canary job queued but FAILED to allocate reserved GPUs in eu-west1: `InsufficientCapacityError`.
Ben K: :rotating_light: we hit capacity in eu-west1 for reserved pool. Two options: 1) route canary to eu-west2 dedicated pool, 2) spill to shared pool with lower priority (higher latency). Prefer eu-west2 for quickness.
Carol S: I vote eu-west2. Also request explicit rollback criteria: if 5xx rate > 1% over 3m or token latency P95 increases >200ms, rollback immediately. Add monitoring alerts and an annotation in release notes.
OnCall: Affirming SLO risk. If we spill to shared pool, expect transient latency spikes. Approve expedited window if we limit canary to 5% initially and keep strict auto-rollback.
Dave R: I can manually pin the image and kick canary in eu-west2. Command I'll run: `releasetool pin --service embeddings --image registry.redwood/embeddings:hotfix-2026-03-21 --region eu-west2 --canary 5% --auto-rollback true`.
Alice M: Sounds good. Who can bless quick smoke tests? I need one dev + one infra ack. Smoke checklist: health endpoint OK, embedding vector dims correct, no OOM in logs, kv-cache eviction rate down.
Ben K: I'll run infra smoke (kv eviction metrics + GPU mem). Give me 5m after canary starts.
Carol S: I'll run model-output sanity tests and a small eval prompt set. If >95% pass we proceed to 50%.
DeployBot: action: `canary start` for embeddings in eu-west2 at 2026-03-21T14:32Z, canary id: cb-6912346789.
DeployBot: log snippet: `ERROR: kv_cache eviction exceeded threshold 0.8 -> triggering hotfix path`. (previous failure in eu-west1 was capacity, not the artifact.)
OnCall: Approved for expedited window under the stated criteria. Page me if rollback triggered.
Alice M: All right. Dave, kick it and post the canary id. I'll update release notes and mention rollback criteria. :thumbsup:
Dave R: kicked it. Canary id cb-6912346789. Starting 5% traffic to eu-west2 dedicated pool.
Ben K: infra smoke running: `curl -sS http://embed-eu-west2/health` -> `{"ok":true}`. KV eviction metric trending down on first 90s.
Carol S: quick eval: 48/50 prompts OK, two failures are prompt formatting edge cases unrelated to model. Moving to 50% pending next 3m monitor.
DeployBot: canary metrics: 5xx_rate=0.12%, P95_latency +60ms. All within rollback thresholds.
Alice M: moving to 50% now. tagging release notes: "Hotfix: kv-cache eviction fix; emergency rollout to eu-west2; auto-rollback on 5xx>1% or P95+200ms."
OnCall: monitoring active. Setting a 10m watch.
Dave R: 50% done, no anomalies for 6m. Proceeding to full ramp.
Ben K: full ramp started. Confirming dedicated pool capacity held.
DeployBot: deploy complete. version pinned: registry.redwood/embeddings:hotfix-2026-03-21 (pinned by Dave R).
Alice M: thanks team. Postmortem to follow with root cause (cache eviction policy regression) and recommendation to add capacity fallback earlier. :white_check_mark:
Carol S: adding note to the release: "manual canary in eu-west2 due to reserved capacity shortfall in eu-west1; full rollout successful; follow-up: autoscale reserved pool and add earlier spillover policy."
DeployBot: closing thread for canary cb-6912346789.
